import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a more descriptive column for fraud status for better legend labels
df['fraud_status'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Not Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})

# Set up the matplotlib figure and axes for a 1x3 subplot layout
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(20, 6))
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid') # Use a professional style

# --- Plot 1: Distribution of Transaction Amount by Fraud Status ---
sns.kdeplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='fraud_status', fill=True, common_norm=False, ax=axes[0], palette='viridis', linewidth=2)
axes[0].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amount by Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[0].tick_params(labelsize=10)
axes[0].legend(title='Fraud Status', title_fontsize='11', fontsize='10')


# --- Plot 2: Transaction Frequency by Hour of Day and Fraud Status ---
# Using `multiple='stack'` to show the total transaction count and the fraud breakdown
sns.histplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', hue='fraud_status', multiple='stack', bins=24, ax=axes[1], palette='viridis', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[1].set_title('Transaction Frequency by Hour of Day and Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day (0-23)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2)) # Show every other hour for better readability
axes[1].tick_params(labelsize=10)
axes[1].legend(title='Fraud Status', title_fontsize='11', fontsize='10')


# --- Plot 3: Transaction Type Distribution by Fraud Status ---
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='fraud_status', ax=axes[2], palette='viridis', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[2].set_title('Transaction Type Distribution by Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[2].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[2].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=10) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability if needed
axes[2].tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
axes[2].legend(title='Fraud Status', title_fontsize='11', fontsize='10')


# Adjust layout to prevent overlapping titles and labels
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
